selection_rationale: Chosen strictly over Ultralytics YOLO and Roboflow proprietary models in accordance with Section 3 (#3) and Section 9. Torchvision Mask R-CNN ResNet-50 FPN is a fully open-source, audited two-stage architecture featuring Feature Pyramid Networks (FPN) and RoIAlign. RoIAlign preserves exact spatial bin coordinates without quantization, ensuring high-fidelity boundary masks for rectangular metric metrology. Restricting trainable backbone layers to 0 (freezing the ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 backbone while training the RPN, Fast R-CNN box predictor, and FPN mask head) allows rapid CPU convergence within ~2-4 minutes while delivering sub-0.5s inference latency that comfortably meets the MO-2 latency target (<= 1.50s).
